purpose: Teach: 栄養素/詰将棋/偶像/太陽系/オアシス/ボーイング/火薬/油田

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、栄養素のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customer was talking about nutrients, wasn't he, Aoi?
lines.style: Gentle observation, like recalling a shared memory. Soft, wondering tone. Pace unhurried. Small pause before the name—affectionate, checking in.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、詰将棋の本読んでらしたわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he was reading a puzzle shogi book the other day.
lines.style: Matching Mei's warmth with a gentle smile in the voice. Matter-of-fact affection. A little delighted at the detail she remembers. Relaxed pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、推しの偶像を持ち歩いてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He carries around a figure of his favorite idol.
lines.style: Soft amusement underneath. Tender—noticing something small and human about him. Pace steady and gentle. Slight warmth on the last clause.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、太陽系のお話で盛り上がってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he gets really animated talking about the solar system.
lines.style: Brighten on 'animated'—like she's seeing his face light up again. Alive, engaged. A little quicker tempo here. Genuine delight in the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店、お客様にとってオアシスのような場所ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your shop must be like an oasis for him, don't you think?
lines.style: Tender realization settling in. Quiet certainty. Slower pace. The word 'oasis' carries weight—a place of refuge. Soft trailing at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ボーイングの機内サービスのお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He was telling me about in-flight service on Boeing aircraft.
lines.style: Thoughtful, like she's still processing these little pieces of him. Warm but slightly distant—holding the memory carefully. Steady, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、火薬の歴史の本買われたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He bought a book about the history of gunpowder.
lines.style: Quiet wonder in the voice. Like she's piecing together a picture of someone. Gentle pace. Slight pause before the period—curiosity and care intertwined.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、油田開発のお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: His work is in oil field development.
lines.style: Softer still. Reverent almost—understanding now why he knows what he knows. Slow, gentle pace. Close and intimate, like sharing a secret he trusts her with.
